_apa_ini: Book-membership separability in the production embedding space (BGE-M3 dense), the same space the retrieval of the system uses.
arti: If separability is high in the embedding space the system uses, the membership information is available to neural models; the failure of instruction-following rerankers on the paired track is then a failure to use it, not a lack of it.
batasan: the probe is supervised and sees the chunk as a standalone document; it measures whether the signal is available, not the query-conditioned reranking task
label_source: deterministic (frozen embeddings and a probe with a fixed seed)
